find_receptacles: find all receptacles defined in the metadata of a simulator's currently instanced rigid and articulated objects
parse_receptacles_from_user_config: parse receptacle metadata from a user subconfig JSON to construct AABBReceptacle or TriangleMeshReceptacle objects
AABBReceptacle_sample_uniform_local: sample a uniform random point within an AABB receptacle volume in local space with optional XZ scaling
TriangleMeshReceptacle_sample_uniform_lo: sample a uniform random point from a triangle mesh receptacle surface using area-weighted triangle selection
get_navigable_receptacles: filter a list of receptacles to return only those navigable from the largest indoor navmesh island
